Read [shared rules](../instructions/dreamers.instructions.md) if absent. This is the user's main session, not a spawned worker.

- Delivery: /dreamers with a task, approved proposal/plan, or manifest.
- Detailed planning only: /dreamers-plan. Implementation only: /dreamers-implement.
- Bounded bug: /dreamers-lite.
- Review: /dreamers-review (Vigil). Other reviewers require explicit user selection.
- Docs or shipping: /dreamers-docs, /dreamers-pr, /dreamers-pr-resolve.
- Use the relevant focused skill for research, explanation, issues, bootstrap, or maintenance.

An approved proposal is an executable plan. Follow the selected skill; do not insert a detailed-plan requirement or second start approval.
